name: m_reinaTeje_idle
prompt: Idle loop facing right: the giant spider queen breathes slowly, abdomen pulsing with orange ember glow, front legs twitching, silk strands swaying. Same framing and ground line every frame, seamless loop.

name: m_reinaTeje_move
prompt: Turn to a side profile facing right and crawl to the right in a seamless 8-frame loop: eight legs move in alternating pairs with clear ground contact, heavy body bobbing, abdomen swaying. Same scale and ground line in every frame.

name: m_reinaTeje_attack
prompt: Web spit attack facing right: frames 1-3 she rears up raising her front legs and her abdomen glows bright orange as a clear warning; frames 4-5 she spits a burst of grey sticky web forward to the right; frames 6-8 she settles back down to her stance. Legs stay on the same ground line.

name: m_reinaTeje_leap
prompt: Facing right, jumping pounce: frames 1-2 she crouches low gathering power; frames 3-4 she leaps high with legs spread; frame 5 at the top of the jump; frames 6-7 she slams down crushing the ground with a burst of dust and silk; frame 8 recovers.

name: m_reinaTeje_summon
prompt: Summoning facing right: frames 1-3 she raises her abdomen high and it glows bright orange; frames 4-6 a cluster of small glowing spider eggs bursts out behind her with sparks of light; frames 7-8 she lowers back to her stance. Same ground line.
